SELECT COALESCE(100*SUM(metric_value)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='CLUSTER_REVIEW_DECISION' AND evaluation_time>=DATE_SUB(#{at},INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND evaluation_time<#{at}
